title: Jobs to Be Done — Overview
summary: Customers 'hire' products to make progress in specific circumstances — design for the job, not the buyer.
body:
Customers 'hire' products to make progress in specific circumstances — design for the job, not the buyer. Popularized by Clayton Christensen.

Approaches commonly used alongside it include Personas, Value Proposition, Customer Interviews.
